transcript.statement: Trustworthiness is paramount in the RollCall system to protect sensitive student attendance data. My requirements ensure data is encrypted (TRU-01), access is controlled (TRU-02), and all actions are logged (TRU-03) for accountability. Students must authenticate to view their records (TRU-04), and data integrity must be verified (TRU-05). Additionally, mechanisms for reporting breaches (TRU-06) and enforcing session timeouts (TRU-07) are essential for maintaining security and privacy.

transcript.statement: The RollCall system must prioritize ethical and compliance standards to protect student data and ensure accountability. My requirements ensure compliance with data protection regulations (RES-01), transparency in attendance recording (RES-02), and a formal dispute process for students (RES-03). Additionally, anonymizing attendance reports (RES-04) protects student identities, while timely notifications (RES-05) keep students informed. Role-based access control (RES-06) ensures only authorized personnel access sensitive data, and maintaining historical data for five years (RES-07) complies with educational regulations. These requirements are essential for fostering trust and responsibility in the system.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization to maintain accurate attendance records across multiple classes.
The system shall implement a comprehensive logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability and transparency.
The system shall store historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to support long-term analysis and compliance.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records only after successful authentication.
The system shall ensure attendance data is processed in real-time to provide updates within 2 seconds of input.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms to minimize energy consumption during data processing operations.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement load balancing to optimize resource utilization across multiple classes and semesters.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second.
